reason: My wife and the office already pick up most calls, and the ones I miss are mostly older customers on a landline who will never see an SMS or WhatsApp. I'm not paying 149 a month plus 990 setup for a fix to a problem I mostly don't have, from a company with zero customers.
objection: Half my callers are pensioners on a landline; a text to a landline goes nowhere, so the people I actually lose are the ones this can't reach.
would_change_my_mind: If landline callers got a spoken message and could leave their request by voice, and it cost under 50 a month with no setup fee and a free month to prove it pays off.
